transportFinding.conclusion: The exact nested DNS lookup failure, fresh per-call Undici Agent, and absence of a provider HTTP response are adequate technical evidence that this POST failed before an HTTP request reached api.openai.com.
transportFinding.mechanism: The pinned dispatch code constructs a new Undici Agent immediately before the POST. Undici's installed HTTPS connector calls tls.connect with host api.openai.com; getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND is emitted while resolving that host, before a TCP/TLS connection can carry HTTP bytes. The catch branch records unknown_cost conservatively for all transport errors.
transportFinding.elapsedTimeRole: The 71 ms elapsed time corroborates an early lookup failure; it is not independently decisive.
proves: This local attempt did not obtain an HTTP status, provider response ID, or token usage.
The recorded failure occurred at DNS resolution for the direct API hostname, before this attempt could transmit an HTTP POST through the fresh connection.
doesNotProve: An invoice amount or account-wide billing state.
The outcome or billing of earlier unknown-cost calls.
That DNS, authentication, or model availability has since recovered.
That a later retry will complete, be accepted, or pass composition review.
transportFinding.billingClaim: No invoice or provider billing amount is asserted by this assessment.
